contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine, Trier mint, Constantinopolis commemorative issue, Reece period 17, RIC vol. 7 no. 543, issue of 332-333. Obverse description: Helmeted bust mantled left with trident/reversed spear over shoulder. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINOPOLIS. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow, diagonal spear, shield propped right. In exergue: TR.S.…
